# function: name

Fills `config.template` with `config.static` plus the variable parts in `variables`. Define `config` once (a local or module output) and pass it to every call.

## Example Usage

```terraform
locals {
  naming = provider::naming::scheme(
    "{org}-{env}-{region}-{type}-{name}",
    { org = "acme", env = "prod", region = "weu" },
  )
}

# acme-prod-weu-rg-network
output "resource_group_name" {
  value = provider::naming::name(local.naming, { type = "rg", name = "network" })
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
name(config object, variables map of string) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `config` (Object) Object with `template` (string with `{key}` placeholders) and `static` (map of module-wide values; use {} for none).
1. `variables` (Map of String) Values for the placeholders not set in `config.static`.
